zh: 数值都小于 1024，所以 OR 结果只有 1024 种；对同一个 OR 值，只需记住达到它的递增子序列中最小的末尾值，末尾越小以后能接的数越多。
设 last[mask] 为 OR 等于 mask 的严格递增子序列的最小末尾值（空子序列对应 last[0]=0）；读到 v 时，所有 last[mask]<v 的状态都能接上 v，转移到 mask|v，末尾值为 v。
last 全部初始化为“不可达”（例如 1024），last[0]=0；对每个元素 v，遍历 mask=0..1023，若 last[mask]<v 则 last[mask|v]=min(last[mask|v], v)（新状态末尾为 v，不会在同一轮被再次用来接 v）；最后收集所有可达的 mask，先输出个数，再按升序输出这些值（包含 0）。
en: All values are below 1024, so there are only 1024 possible OR results; for each OR value it is enough to remember the smallest last element of an increasing subsequence reaching it, since a smaller tail can be extended by more numbers later.

Let last[mask] be the smallest final value of a strictly increasing subsequence whose OR is mask (the empty subsequence gives last[0] = 0); on reading v, every state with last[mask] < v can take v and moves to mask | v with tail v.

Initialise every last to unreachable (for example 1024) and last[0] = 0; for each element v loop mask over 0..1023 and, if last[mask] < v, set last[mask | v] = min(last[mask | v], v) (the new state ends with v, so it cannot take v again in the same round); finally collect every reachable mask and print their count, then the values in ascending order (0 included).

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each OR value keep only the smallest last value of a reachable increasing subsequence; on reading v, move from every state whose last value is < v to OR|v.

## Proof of correctness

For the same OR value, a smaller last value means a larger set of numbers can be appended later, so keeping the smallest last value loses no future feasible plan. A state can take v only if its last value is < v, so the transition is exact; the new state has last value v, which can never again be strictly smaller than v in the same round, so the current position is not reused. The initial empty sequence can take any positive number, and induction covers all subsequences.

## Complexity

O(1024n) time, O(1024) space.
